answer_1.quote: We present NL-EDIT, an edit-based model for interactive text-to-SQL with natural language feedback. ... we pose the correction task as a semantic parsing problem that aims to convert natural language feedback to a sequence of edits that can be deterministically applied to the initial parse to correct it.
answer_1.outputs: SQL edits (add/remove operations) that are applied to an initial SQL query to produce a corrected SQL query

answer_2.quote: We follow (Elgohary et al., 2020) and use the correction accuracy as our main evaluation measure: ... We also note that in 72.4% of the test examples, NL-EDIT was able to strictly reduce the number of errors ... We define another set of metrics to measure partial progress. We report (Edit ↓ and Edit ↑ ...) and the Progress metric.
automatic_metrics: Edit ↓ (percentage of examples with reduced edit size)
Edit ↑ (percentage of examples with increased edit size)
